31.stem: Match the computer component with its function:
31.why: Keyboard – Input device; Monitor – Output device; CPU – Processing unit.

17.why: The keyboard is an input device for typing, the CPU processes instructions and the monitor displays output.

18.why: Paint is application software, a microphone is an input device and Windows is an operating system.

19.why: A pen drive is portable, RAM is temporary and a hard disk stores data permanently.

32.why: A device driver is system software, Windows is an operating system and a word processor is application software.

52.why: Ctrl + M inserts a new slide, F5 starts the slide show and Ctrl + D duplicates a slide.

53.why: Slide Sorter rearranges slides, Normal view is for editing and Reading view shows the show in a window.

54.why: The Design tab changes themes, the Insert tab adds pictures and the Animations tab adds entrance effects.

70.why: The taskbar is the bar at the bottom, an icon is a small picture and the wallpaper is the background image.

71.why: Right-click shows options and properties, drag and drop moves a file and double-click opens it.

72.why: Ctrl + C copies, Ctrl + X cuts and Ctrl + V pastes.

83.why: Ctrl + I makes text italic, Ctrl + U underlines it and Ctrl + B makes it bold.

84.why: Justified text has even edges on both sides; centred text sits in the middle.

95.why: Speakers output sound, printers print documents, monitors display output, keyboards input data and scanners turn physical images into digital ones.
